command:
set -u; mkdir -p .ai-kodu-runner/results; opencode run --format json -f /workspace/prompt.md 'Implement the attached task. Work directly in the workspace, run the required checks, and do not commit or push.'; agent_rc=$?; flutter pub get > .ai-kodu-runner/results/flutter-pub-get.log 2>&1; pub_rc=$?; flutter analyze > .ai-kodu-runner/results/flutter-analyze.log 2>&1; analyze_rc=$?; dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test > .ai-kodu-runner/results/dart-format.log 2>&1; format_rc=$?; flutter test --machine > .ai-kodu-runner/results/flutter-test.json 2> .ai-kodu-runner/results/flutter-test.stderr; test_rc=$?; printf '{"agent":%s,"pub_get":%s,"analyze":%s,"format":%s,"test":%s}
' "$agent_rc" "$pub_rc" "$analyze_rc" "$format_rc" "$test_rc" > .ai-kodu-runner/results/summary.json; [ $agent_rc -eq 0 ] && [ $pub_rc -eq 0 ] && [ $analyze_rc -eq 0 ] && [ $format_rc -eq 0 ] && [ $test_rc -eq 0 ]
